```python
def init_caus( 
    n: int, 
    rng=np.random.default_rng()
) -> list[float]:
    # Caustic initialization producing oscillating peaks
    pos = np.arange(n) / (n-1) * 10
    heights = 1 + 0.5 * np.cos(pos)**2
    # Apply smoothing
    smoothed = median_filter(heights, max(1, n//20))
    return list(smoothed / smoothed.sum())
```
